en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a city scene with railway tracks and freight cars in the foreground and large brick and stone institutional buildings on a rocky hill in the background. One prominent building has a clock tower and spire, and another has ornate facades with domes and gables. Text at the bottom left identifies the view and city; a small publisher credit appears at the bottom right.
